race.comment: KILLENAULE (8) has placed in all four runs this time in with a win looking close. He was heavily backed at Caulfield Heath last time but just couldn't get in after drawing out and racing wide without cover on a solid tempo throughout. His effort was good and with a better run in transit here he can break through. MELEK (4) presents third up having quickly risen to this trip at Ballarat second up and running on strongly for second. Drawn wide here so likely goes back but look for him late. FRANK WHISPER (12) was off a let up leading in a 3yo race at Caulfield and running on well. Not sure of the strength of that form but he'll be fitter and appreciate the trip. PLACENTIA BAY (9) is racing well without winning and will give a sight again. TERRORTORIAN (5) next best.
